# Sarthak Agrawal

> Personal site of Sarthak Agrawal — AI infrastructure and product engineer. Portfolio, shipped products, and technical writing.

Built on Astro, deployed on Cloudflare Pages. Part of the Foundry personal product fleet.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/): Hero, selected work, and contact
- [Projects](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/projects): Current product fleet grouped by focus, support/platform, and personal use, plus curated open-source repos
- [About](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/about): Background, stack, and availability
- [Résumé](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/resume): On-site résumé and PDF download
- [Writing](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/blog): Devlog and technical posts
- [Privacy](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/terms): Terms of use
- [Fleet performance without Argo](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/blog/fleet-performance-without-argo): Case study on closing desktop LCP p75 under 500 ms across 23 Cloudflare sites

## Product fleet

### Focus

- [CodeVetter](https://codevetter.com): Desktop-first AI code review for agent-generated diffs
- [Pace](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/pace): Local-only macOS voice agent
- [PostTrainLLM](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/tinygpt): Post-training and small-language-model learning workspace

### Support/platform

- [Foundry / SaaS Maker](https://sassmaker.com): Personal fleet operating layer and product showcase
- [High Signal](https://highsignal.app): Public signal log for AI infrastructure, markets, and domain intelligence
- [AliveVille](https://aliveville.com): Interactive AI world experiment
- [Free AI](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/free-ai): OpenAI-compatible gateway for free-tier model providers
- [Knowledge Base](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/knowledge-base): Private Agent Search over project-scoped corpora
- [Reel Pipeline](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/reel-pipeline): AI short-form video generation pipeline
- [Research Papers](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/research-papers): Academic paper platform and research data asset
- [drank](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/drank): Domain Rating tracker for domain research
- [Starboard](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/starboard): GitHub stars organizer and semantic search surface

### Personal use

- [RolePatch](https://rolepatch.com): AI resume tailoring against job descriptions
- [Karte](https://karte.cc): AI link-in-bio and inbound assistant
- [Significant Hobbies](https://significanthobbies.com): Hobby journey mapping and discovery
- [Reader](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/reader): Personal reading and saved-article workflow
- [SWE Interview Prep](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/swe-interview-prep): Interview practice workspace
- [LoopTV](https://github.com/sarthak-fleet/looptv): Ambient video and anime companion
- [Anime List](https://anime-list-9lk.pages.dev): Personal anime discovery and tracking surface
- [Email Manager](https://email-manager.sarthakagrawal927.workers.dev): Personal email operations workspace
